title: The connect_social_home action's `sealed` variable (a JSON string): the claim and the dashboard address sealed to the panel's X25519 key

suite.description: The sealing suite. Receivers refuse every value they don't implement (no default): today only x25519-hkdf-sha256-aes256gcm.

epk.description: The sender's ephemeral X25519 public key, unpadded base64url (32 bytes).

nonce.description: The AES-256-GCM nonce, unpadded base64url (12 bytes).

ct.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext followed by its 16-byte tag, unpadded base64url (17 to 2048 bytes). Opens to {"claim", "url"}.
